goals.description: Inspect the workspace read-only and publish concrete preload plans for every later goal.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Inspect /workspace read-only to identify the requested widget or feature, repository layout, likely scope, existing implementations, close precedents, test harnesses, exports, and package commands. Do not edit files, build, or run tests. Incrementally publish predictable instructions for each later goal, including likely files to read, directories or symbols to explore, commands to run, and relevant workspace-state assumptions. Make exactly one set_preload_plan call for each goal plan G001 through G007, using JSON shaped exactly like {"goals":{"G001":["relative/path/from/workspace"]}} with the corresponding goal ID and concrete relative paths; independent plans may be published as multiple tool calls in one response. You may complete G001 with set_goal_resolution(kind="completed_by_planner") if you actually perform its full read-only audit and provide concise successor context, or mark a conditional read-only goal no_action only when current evidence proves it unnecessary. Do not resolve any required write, build, test, or work depending on effects not yet present.
goals.name: Plan the port

goals.description: Audit widget coverage and determine the exact porting branch and established patterns to follow.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Run scripts/audit_widget_coverage.py for the requested kebab-case widget before any editing, using --repo if needed. Inspect the current connector, wrappers, exports, shared tests, placeholders, and skipped tests. Classify the request as an existing-connector wrapper, a shared-connector variant, or a connector/render-state change. Identify one close precedent in the target flavor and one in another flavor; for newer Vue recommendation, chat, or filter-suggestion work also inspect Hits.js, Highlighter.js, DynamicWidgets.js, and util/vue-compat.js. Report the required layers, expected $$widgetType, UMD constraints, sharing model, and whether examples are relevant. This goal is read-only.
goals.name: Audit scope and precedents

goals.description: Implement the required instantsearch.js connector and JavaScript widget portions, including their exports.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Inspect the requested feature and current repository state, rerunning the coverage audit if needed. Implement only the required packages/instantsearch.js connector and JavaScript widget layers. Preserve an existing connector API when only a wrapper is missing; for a known or analogous variant, reuse the existing connector and give the wrapper its distinct $$widgetType instead of creating a connector. When the connector or render state is genuinely missing or changing, implement it and update connector exports in src/connectors/index.ts and index.umd.ts. Implement or adjust the JavaScript widget using established adjacent patterns and shared instantsearch-ui-components markup where appropriate, then update src/widgets/index.ts and index.umd.ts. Respect intentional UMD exclusions such as chat. Do not modify React, Vue, common tests, examples, or unrelated APIs.
goals.name: Implement shared connector and JavaScript layer

goals.description: Add or update the React hook, UI, widget wrapper, and public exports required by the port.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Inspect the requested feature, current connector API, existing React coverage, and close React precedents. Implement only the required React layer. Add or update the react-instantsearch-core hook and its src/index.ts export when a dedicated hook is required; for a variant, reuse the existing hook directly. Implement the React widget with matching props, escape hatches, and $$widgetType. Prefer instantsearch-ui-components when markup is shareable; otherwise put all React-rendered markup, including simple markup such as a select, in react-instantsearch/src/ui/<Pascal>.tsx. Avoid memoization not justified by an adjacent widget. Export the widget from react-instantsearch/src/widgets/index.ts and index.umd.ts while respecting UMD availability. Do not edit common test suites, the all-widgets test utility, Vue, JavaScript widgets, or examples.
goals.name: Implement the React layer

goals.description: Add or update the Vue wrapper and its public widget export using established compatibility patterns.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Inspect the requested feature, connector contract, current Vue coverage, placeholders, and close Vue precedents. Implement only the required Vue wrapper and packages/vue-instantsearch/src/widgets.js export. Reuse the existing connector for variants and keep $$widgetType aligned with the corresponding widget across flavors. Use a .vue SFC for slot-heavy markup, or a .js render function with renderCompat when reusing instantsearch-ui-components. Follow existing createWidgetMixin, createSuitMixin, scoped-slot, and Vue compatibility patterns rather than introducing a new abstraction. Rely on the existing automatic re-export and plugin registration from widgets.js. Do not edit common suites or flavor test registries, React, instantsearch.js, or examples.
goals.name: Implement the Vue layer

goals.description: Add or update behavioral suites and register the widget or connector in every affected flavor test harness.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Inspect the requested scope and all implementations currently present. Update tests/common/widgets/<widget>/ whenever wrapper behavior is introduced or changed, and tests/common/connectors/<widget>/ only when connector parameters or render state changed. Match existing suite style and cover the relevant public behavior rather than implementation details. Register affected suites in each flavor's common-widgets.test.* and common-connectors.test.* harnesses. Replace target-flavor unsupported placeholders with real setup and remove the corresponding skippedTests entries. If a React widget was added or changed, always add it with valid minimum props to packages/react-instantsearch/src/widgets/__tests__/__utils__/all-widgets.tsx. Add focused flavor-specific tests only where the established neighboring pattern requires behavior not covered by the common suite. Do not redesign production APIs or add examples.
goals.name: Wire shared and flavor tests

goals.description: Integrate the widget into an existing example only when it is user-facing and fits an established example experience.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Determine from the request and current repository whether the widget is user-facing and whether an existing example already provides the appropriate product surface. Search getting-started, query-suggestions, recommendation, chat, and e-commerce examples before editing. Add or update an example only when it demonstrates the feature naturally; use examples/*/e-commerce only when the widget fits the shared storefront UX or existing Playwright coverage. Follow the chosen example's existing flavor and layout patterns and avoid creating a gratuitous new example. If no example is warranted, make no changes and report why. Do not alter library implementation or shared test suites.
goals.name: Update a relevant example

goals.description: Run focused repository checks across all affected layers and correct only integration defects found by those checks.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Inspect the final workspace state and package scripts, then rerun the widget coverage audit. Run the narrowest applicable common widget and connector suites for every affected flavor, relevant flavor-specific tests, and targeted type-check, lint, or build commands used by the touched packages. Verify exports, $$widgetType consistency, variant connector reuse, removed placeholders and skips, React all-widgets coverage, Vue registration, and intentional UMD availability. If an example changed, run its applicable focused check or test. Diagnose failures and make only minimal corrections directly required for this port; do not expand scope or refactor unrelated code. Report commands run, results, and any remaining environment-caused limitation.
goals.name: Validate the integrated port
